pred_ddx.label: Cushing's syndrome due to ectopic ACTH-producing tumor

The presence of an autonomous adenoma in the thyroid gland and a tumor mass in the abdomen supports the diagnosis of an ectopic ACTH-producing tumor.
Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN: The patient's complex clinical picture and multiple endocrine abnormalities raise the possibility of MEN1, but this diagnosis is less likely given the absence of other characteristic features such as primary hyperparathyroidism and the presence of a single, well-defined tumor mass in the abdomen.
